_description: Handwritten sample logs and their expected results for optional Doctor checks. Each scenario gives the mode, suites, input files and expected raw JSON records. Expected results are written independently of parser output so a parser mistake cannot define its own passing answer. These are synthetic examples, not hardware results.

provenance.note: Synthetic logs and independently specified raw identities; CI overall-compliance expectations are intentionally not imported.

extensions.source: Handwritten completed-log examples reviewed against reserved_memory_map_checker.py and dtb_alignment_test.py producer messages; expected identities and counts specified independently of parser output.

Handwritten producer-shaped PCIe audit logs; PJ03164-4076 defines SR-only Recommended results using numeric counts: zero ROM devices means SKIPPED, otherwise zero non-compliant devices means PASSED, otherwise FAILED. Printed Result Summary intentionally disagrees to verify that it does not override those counts.
